reminders.whatsappTemplate: Hello {name}, this is a reminder of your dental appointment on {date} at {time}. See you soon!
reminders.emailBody:
Hello {name},

This is a friendly reminder of your dental appointment on {date} at {time}.

If you need to reschedule, just reply to this email or call us.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic
reminders.recallWhatsapp: Hello {name}, it has been {months} months since your last check-up. Would you like to book an appointment? We would be glad to see you.
reminders.recallEmailBody:
Hello {name},

Our records show your last visit was {last}. A check-up every few months keeps small problems small.

Just reply to this email or call us to book a time that suits you.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic
reminders.followUpWhatsapp: Hello {name}, it has been {days} days since your treatment. How are you feeling? Let us know if anything is bothering you.
reminders.followUpEmailSubject: How are you feeling after your treatment?
reminders.followUpEmailBody:
Hello {name},

It has been {days} days since we treated you ({services}). We wanted to check how you are getting on.

If anything is painful or does not feel right, reply to this email or call us and we will see you.

Kind regards,
The dental clinic
reminders.waitlistWhatsapp: Hello {name}, a slot has opened up on {day} at {time}. Would you like it? Let us know and we will hold it for you.
reminders.confirmAsk: Please let us know if you are coming: {link}
